Independent full-vertex Laplacian Taylor-action check at (m,t) in {2,3,5} × {0,0.3,1.2}, comparing the bridge mass, signs and pendant upper bound
correctness.rationale: With counting measure, symmetry and sup-norm duality give the edge norm as the l1 mass of H(t)(delta_u-delta_v). The antisymmetric hub/leaf generator has entries (-(m+2),m;1,-1); it preserves left-half nonnegativity. The left-half mass has initial value 1 and derivative -2, yielding the two positive bridge coefficients and sign-input extremizer (at t=0 the zero leaf components pose no issue). The pendant mass splits into leaf differences of rate 1, the symmetric hub/leaf contrast of rate m+1, and two antisymmetric modes. Checking their leaf coefficients using a'=h-a gives the two stated remainder amplitudes, at most 2/m and 3, respectively. With lambda_- of order 1/m and lambda_+ of order m, the weighted pendant supremum is uniformly bounded. For the bridge, after writing y=lambda_- t, the fast weighted exponential is uniformly negligible relative to the slow prefactor, by max_y sqrt(y)exp(-r y)=1/sqrt(2er). The slow profile sqrt(y)exp(-y) has a unique maximum at y=1/2 and vanishes at both ends, so every maximizing time has lambda_- t→1/2. Since m lambda_-→2 and c_-→1, the rescaled optimum tends to e^(-1/2) and t/m→1/4. Finite positive maximizing times exist by continuity and the endpoint decay of edge masses; the pendant bound yields strict bridge superiority at all sufficiently large optimizing m.
residual_risks: The nine bounded checks are only corroboration. No first integer threshold for bridge dominance or finite-m uniqueness of the maximizing time is established or claimed.

value.rationale: The family gives a quantitative sharp obstruction to degree-independent t^(-1/2) smoothing even among diameter-three unit-edge trees with the counting-measure Laplacian. The exact bridge law and the proof that the bridge alone controls the large-m optimum distinguish slow bottleneck dynamics from faster local leaf dynamics, information not supplied by a generic spectral-gap estimate.
residual_risks: The argument concerns symmetric bistars and this normalization only; it does not assert a classification of all trees or a degree-normalized analogue.
